outages.headline: Route Avoidance Is No Longer Enough: The Houthis Strike a Saudi Tanker Off Yanbu
outages.summary: The Houthi campaign has moved beyond the assumption that geographic distance provides protection. NCC WAFA was struck off Yanbu on August 5 on a purely domestic Saudi coastal run from Yanbu to Jizan, hundreds of kilometers from the declared Bab el-Mandeb blockade zone and running dark since July 19. outages.headline: Russian oil product exports hit decade low in July amid Ukraine strikes
outages.summary: Russian seaborne exports of petroleum refined products fell to the lowest in at least 10 years in July, while crude exports remained high, despite falling from a June peak, according to cargo-tracking data, as Ukraine continued strikes on Russian refining infrastructure. outages.headline: U.S. Diesel Exports Hit Record High as Global Supply Crunch Deepens
outages.summary: US distillate exports surged to a record last week as global supplies tightened. Disruptions across the Gulf area and various surrounding maritime chokepoints, as well as Ukrainian one-way attack drone strikes that have paralyzed portions of Russia's energy infrastructure, have been a major boon for US refiners and export terminals along the Gulf of America.
